import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

main=Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
group=sys.argv[1]
root=Path('/tmp/p49-terminal-'+group)
tool=Path('docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools')
out=main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/phase2/execution'/group/'checkers'
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
venv=Path('/tmp/p49-a0-regression-43a6aa6')
python=str(venv/'bin/python')
env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1',
    PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join(str(p) for p in sorted(root.glob('*/scripts'))))
env.pop('MYPYPATH',None)
env['PATH']=str(venv/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin'
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
commands=[]
def add(name,file,*args,expected=0):
    commands.append((name,[python,str(tool/file),*map(str,args)],expected))
add('symbol','symbol_audit.py')
add('bridge','table_audit_bridge.py')
add('design-doc','check_design_doc.py','docs/clang-fix-campaign/design.md')
add('design-doc-controls','check_design_doc.py','--self-test')
for fixture in ('skill-owner-shared-consumer','skill-owner-peer-skill-consumer',
                'duplicate-spec-root-mismatch','twin-both-name-only','import-binding-legacy-alias'):
    add('symbol-negative-'+fixture,'symbol_audit.py','--negative-fixture',fixture,expected=1)
for fixture in ('source-twin-only','twin-both-binary-key'):
    add('symbol-key-'+fixture,'symbol_audit.py','--key-fixture',fixture)
for fixture in ('regression-lock','aliased-import','same-name-import','planned-run-git'):
    add('symbol-binding-'+fixture,'symbol_audit.py','--binding-fixture',fixture)
add('symbol-surface','symbol_audit.py','--surface-fixture','mixed-case-alias',expected=1)
add('bridge-binary','table_audit_bridge.py','--key-fixture','twin-both-binary-key')
add('bridge-name-only','table_audit_bridge.py','--negative-fixture','twin-both-name-only',expected=1)
for fixture in ('missing-destination','wrong-definition','wrong-owner','source-remains','mapping-contract','source-table-mismatch'):
    add('relocation-'+fixture,'table_audit_bridge.py','--relocation-negative',fixture,expected=1)
for fixture in ('one','two','three'):
    add('synthetic-'+fixture,'table_audit_bridge.py','--relocation-synthetic',fixture)
for skill,suffix in ((4,''),(5,'.skill5'),(6,'.skill6')):
    data=tool/('design_drift_ledger'+suffix+'.json')
    add(f'ledger{skill}-check','design_drift_ledger.py','check','--data',data)
    if skill != 6:
        add(f'ledger{skill}-admission','design_drift_ledger.py',
            'admission-v19' if skill==4 else 'admission','--data',data,expected=1)
    add(f'ledger{skill}-out-of-scope','design_drift_ledger.py','negative-fixture','out-of-scope-misuse','--data',data,expected=1)
    for binding in json.loads((root/data).read_text())['bindings']:
        add(f'ledger{skill}-'+binding['id'],'design_drift_ledger.py','negative-binding',binding['id'],'--data',data,expected=1)
for action in ('check','parser-only','admission-v17'):
    add('branch-'+action,'branch_inventory.py',action,expected=1 if action=='admission-v17' else 0)
add('terminal-predicates','terminal_predicates.py',tool/'p49_terminal_data/predicates.json')
add('terminal-expected-diff','terminal_expected_diff.py','check')
for control in ('normal','extra-change','missed-change','empty-reason','impossible-registration',
                'missing-mode','unknown-mode','no-diff-with-differences','empty-diff-set',
                'readers-empty','readers-missing','unchanged-timeout-message'):
    add('terminal-diff-'+control,'terminal_diff_controls.py',control,expected=0 if control=='normal' else 1)
for control in ('normal','premature-item3','missing-item4'):
    add('terminal-phase-'+control,'terminal_phase_controls.py',control,expected=0 if control=='normal' else 1)
results=[]
for name,argv,expected in commands:
    result=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True)
    stdout=result.stdout+result.stderr
    (out/(name+'.log')).write_bytes(stdout)
    row=dict(name=name,argv=argv,cwd=str(root),head=head,expected_exit=expected,
        exit_code=result.returncode,matched=result.returncode==expected,
        log_sha256=hashlib.sha256(stdout).hexdigest())
    results.append(row)
    print(f'{name}: exit={result.returncode} expected={expected} '+('PASS' if row['matched'] else 'FAIL'),flush=True)
    if not row['matched']:
        print(stdout.decode(errors='replace')[-2500:],flush=True)
summary=dict(results=results,environment={k:env.get(k) for k in ('PATH','PYTHONPATH','MYPYPATH','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE')},
    program=Path(__file__).read_text(),failed=[r['name'] for r in results if not r['matched']],
    scope_note='All active design checkers and their controls. Retired E11-5 static discovery is exercised by unit tests, not promoted back into gates. No OBS producer rerun.')
by_name={r['name']:r for r in results}
for prefix,normal in [('terminal-diff-','terminal-diff-normal'),('terminal-phase-','terminal-phase-normal')]:
    if not by_name[normal]['matched']:
        for row in results:
            if row['name'].startswith(prefix):
                row['matched']=False
                row['invalid_reason']='normal control failed; red exit cannot prove mutation rejection'
summary['failed']=[r['name'] for r in results if not r['matched']]
(out/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(f'CHECKERS total={len(results)} failed={len(summary["failed"])}',flush=True)
sys.exit(bool(summary['failed']))
scope_note: All active design checkers and their controls. Retired E11-5 static discovery is exercised by unit tests, not promoted back into gates. No OBS producer rerun.
